OSIRIS Unified Physical Quantum Hardware Evidence Package (v2.0)

This deposition contains the complete empirical evidence, raw shot count dictionaries, compiled instruction-set architecture (ISA) circuits, cryptographic dispatch grants, hardware acquisition receipts, and Merkle-chained ledger records for the OSIRIS Quantum Hardware Research Campaign executed on 156-qubit IBM Quantum Heron processors (ibm_fez and ibm_marrakesh).

Consolidated Hardware Campaigns & Validated Observables:

  • OSIRIS-HP-001 (1-Qubit Subspace Reconstruction, ibm_fez): 49,152 physical shots across 6 transmons; reconstructed subspace population of 80.20 ± 0.62%.
  • OSIRIS-HP-002 (Certified Restricted 1-Qubit Hayden-Preskill Recovery, ibm_fez): 73,728 physical shots; restricted entanglement fidelity of 79.49 ± 0.14% (Z > 200σ, W = -0.2949 < 0) with barrier-verified positive control (91.94%).
  • OSIRIS-HP-003 (Certified 2-Qubit Hayden-Preskill Capacity Bound, ibm_fez): 46,080 physical shots; multi-qubit recovery fidelity of 74.95 ± 0.34% (Z = 73.0σ, W = -0.2495 < 0, Job dbndsvoou4as73b4cvi0). Conclusively validates the quantum capacity theorem: collecting a single photon (Arm B-Def) is bounded at F1 = 42.42% (W1 ≥ 0, unentangled) and F2 = 24.90%, whereas collecting 2 photons achieves +41.29 pp capacity gain.
  • 7-Edge Staggered Dynamical Decoupling Survey (ibm_marrakesh): 86,016 physical shots across 14 transmons; Edge (14, 15) demonstrated +2.28 pp cross-talk suppression with an 86.0% global ensemble win-rate.
  • Forensic Audit Resolution (Records E-44 to E-52): Complete documentation of the methodological quarantine, compiler cancellation remediation, and unbiased dual-pair Pauli tomography redesign.
  • SYS-021 Immutable Cryptographic Ledger: All campaigns are anchored across Blocks #1 through #48 in evidence_ledger.db with unbroken SHA-256 parent-block hash chaining.

Distribution bundle includes native QPY binaries, harvest JSON records, LaTeX manuscript (crsm_nature_physics_2026.tex), and SHA256SUMS.txt.
